Proven fleet pattern from task-router 2026-09-19: a concurrency test fired 40 simultaneous interpreter spawns (fixed: bounded waves of 8, same contract, TR-078); a suite built 66 private seed registries per run (fixed: one shared session build for read-only consumers, private builds kept where inputs mutate, TR-077); missing pandas in a venv turned every seed into a full-core burn for minutes.
